scope_notes: Exact fb7 retained original-profile campaigns only; no 540 data.
Both profiles used 30-second phases, 21 business blocks, 4 seed blocks, 1024 seed transfers, [0,24,24] attacker processes, and separate verifier cpu.max 25000/100000 with no burst.
Corresponding first six decoded Page values are exactly equal; all these imports succeeded and none activates a complete page.
These are separate hosted executions, not lockstep trials; ratios describe finite observations, not a universal causal or throughput guarantee.
Import process CPU encloses decoder/import/activation and includes failed import; network and confirmation are separate.
Native stage deltas span ready-to-final-native-snapshot; AccountGraph/Admission/Activation are nested and not additive with imports or each other.
Strict uses the independent every-native-checkpoint path; zero counters in the optional N8 graph-fence observer mean it was not activated, not that strict performed zero resource checks.
clean_node_close and successful actor exit describe cleanup/report completion, not original business success.
Original outer unit cleanup exit 5 reports already-not-loaded unit and is retained separately from fixed-parent cleanup and business failure.
